title: MYSTIQUE: Few-Shot Facial Identity Transfer with Performance Preservation
abstract: arXiv:2611.32232v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In visual effects, identity transfer replaces the identity in a driving image with that of a target person, while preserving the expression, lighting, pose and scene of that image. Paired ground truth is rarely available, so many methods are trained by self-reconstruction, where the model can learn a shortcut by copying identity cues from the driving image. This shortcut causes identity leakage at inference, where the driving image shows a different person. Our key observation is that leakage can enter through any input that reads the driving image. We therefore present MYSTIQUE, a diffusion-based identity transfer method that takes identity from a set of the target's photos and reads expression, lighting and scene through separate streams. It learns to disentangle identity from the other streams through multi-stage training, with disentanglement strategies at their inputs: a random block mask whose boundaries do not follow the face ou

translated_title: MYSTIQUE：保留表演表现的少样本面部身份迁移
translated_abstract: 在视觉效果领域，身份迁移是指将驱动图像中的人物身份替换为目标人物的身份，同时保留该图像中的表情、光照、姿态和场景。由于配对的真值数据非常稀缺，许多方法采用自重建的方式进行训练，这使得模型可以走捷径，直接从驱动图像中复制身份线索。这种捷径会在推理时导致身份泄露，即驱动图像中显示的是另一个不同的人。我们的关键观察是：身份泄露可以通过任何读取驱动图像的输入通道进入。因此，我们提出了MYSTIQUE，这是一种基于扩散模型的身份迁移方法，它从目标人物的一组照片中提取身份信息，并通过相互分离的独立流读取表情、光照和场景。该方法通过多阶段训练学习将身份与其他信息流解耦，并在各输入处采用解耦策略：一种边界不沿面部轮廓的随机块掩码……
tldr: 提出基于扩散模型的少样本面部身份迁移方法MYSTIQUE，通过将身份与表情、光照、场景分流的输入解耦策略及多阶段训练，有效防止自重建训练带来的身份泄露，同时完整保留驱动图像中的表演表现。
en_tdlr: MYSTIQUE is a diffusion-based few-shot facial identity transfer method that prevents identity leakage from self-reconstruction shortcuts by disentangling identity from expression, lighting, and scene through separate input streams and multi-stage training, while preserving the performance of the driving image.
